Name: False Morel
Author: pitytheviolins
Description:
Have you ever wanted a very specific mod to add one single mushroom and recipe? Really?

Well you're in luck, because this mod adds one new mushroom for foraging in the spring and summer - [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gyromitra_esculenta]Gyromitra esculenta[/url], aka a False Morel, aka the Brain Mushroom (at least that's what my family calls it!).
[b][size=4][center]PSA![/center][/size][/b]Don't eat foraged mushrooms without good knowledge of the area and items! 
These little beauties are toxic raw, but are a delicacy in many places. There are very specific instructions for cooking them safely (see these [url=http://www.dlc.fi/~marianna/gourmet/morel.htm#instrc]official Finnish rules[/url] for processing), and they are illegal to sell in a lot of places. 
﻿Be careful out there, y'all.
